removeQuestion: Delete this configuration? History will be retained.
name: Name
error: Could not load data. Retry the request.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check the fields, resource dependencies and current revision, then retry.
registerInfo: The first registration becomes the only passkey for this installation.
loginError: Passkey verification failed or was cancelled. Try again.
unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use a current browser over HTTPS or localhost.
loginSubmitted: Submitted. Checking the next step automatically.
precision: Timestamps use seconds. Private status and interrupted observation remain unknown.
noTarget: Select a target to view presence.
utcHint: ISO 8601 with an offset, for example 2026-11-07T00:00:00+08:00.
loginPhoneHelp: Your phone number is saved in the account settings. Request a code to continue; you can keep this account.
loginCodeTitle: Step 2: Enter your Telegram login code
loginCodeHelp: Check the delivery instructions below. After verification, you will be asked for your 2FA password if your account requires one.
loginViaTelegram: The code was sent to an existing Telegram session. Open the official Telegram service chat on a signed-in device; this is not an SMS.
loginViaSms: The code was sent by SMS. Check messages received by this phone number.
loginViaCall: Telegram will provide the code in a phone call. Answer the incoming call.
loginViaMissedCall: Enter the last digits of the calling number as instructed by Telegram.
loginPasswordTitle: Step 3: Enter your two-step verification (2FA) password
loginPasswordHelp: Your code was accepted. Enter the two-step verification password you previously set in Telegram.
loginEmailHelp: Enter the email address for this Telegram login. Next, enter the verification code sent there.
loginEmailCodeHelp: Check the email address shown below and enter the Telegram verification code. The next step will appear automatically.
loginReadyHelp: Account verification is complete. You can use this account to monitor presence and run configured tasks.
loginReconnecting: The account is signed in and reconnecting to Telegram. Status updates automatically.
loginInactiveHelp: Enable and save this account first. Login instructions will appear automatically once the service starts.
loginStartingHelp: The session is starting. This section updates automatically; wait for the next instruction.
loginClosedHelp: The service is recovering the session. If it stays closed, disable and save the account, then enable it again.
loginRegistrationTitle: This number is not registered with Telegram
loginRegistrationHelp: Register your account in the official Telegram app, then return here to sign in.
loginPremiumTitle: Telegram requires verification in the official app
loginPremiumHelp: Telegram currently requires a Premium purchase verification. Complete it in the official app, then sign in again.
loginDeviceHelp: Telegram is waiting for confirmation on another signed-in device. Check your official Telegram app.
loginRejected: Telegram could not complete verification. Check the current step and try again.
loginServiceUnavailable: The Telegram backend is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly; you can keep this account.
BackendUnavailable: The backend is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly; you can keep this account.
loginStatusUnavailable: Login status is temporarily unavailable. Select Refresh status to try again.
loginTimeout: Telegram timed out. Refresh status, then retry the current step.
loginRetryAfter: Too many Telegram requests. Wait at least
PHONE_CODE_INVALID: Incorrect login code. Check the most recent Telegram code and try again.
PHONE_CODE_EXPIRED: The login code expired. Start login again to request a new code.
PASSWORD_HASH_INVALID: Incorrect two-step verification (2FA) password. Try again.
PHONE_NUMBER_INVALID: Telegram rejected the phone number. Check the country code and number in account settings, then save.
PHONE_NUMBER_BANNED: Telegram has restricted this phone number. Check the account in the official app or contact Telegram.
PHONE_NUMBER_FLOOD: Too many code requests for this number. Try again later.
API_ID_INVALID: The Telegram API ID or API Hash is invalid. Check both values in account settings and save.
API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD: Telegram restricted these API credentials. Use your own API ID and API Hash from my.telegram.org.
UPDATE_APP_TO_LOGIN: Telegram requires an updated login client. The maintainer needs to update TDLib.
EMAIL_INVALID: Invalid email address. Check it and try again.
EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED: Telegram does not accept this login email. Use a different address.
EMAIL_CODE_INVALID: Incorrect email code. Check the most recent code.
EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED: The email code expired. Request a new code.
LOGIN_STATE_CHANGED: The Telegram login step changed. The page is updating; follow the current instructions.
AUTH_RESTART: Telegram requires login to restart. Refresh status to continue.
RATE_LIMITED: Telegram temporarily limited login requests. Wait before trying again.
TELEGRAM_ERROR_400: Telegram rejected verification. Refresh status and check the saved phone number and API credentials.
TELEGRAM_ERROR_406: Telegram could not complete verification. Check your account in the official app and try again.
monitoringUnavailable: Monitoring status is unavailable; displayed data may be stale
pollCountHelp: Counts come from actual background checks and update automatically. Page refreshes do not increment them. Disabled targets are not counted; totals survive service restarts.
userStatusOffline: Telegram did not provide an exact last-seen time
userStatusRecently: Telegram only reports recently online; no exact time is available
userStatusLastWeek: Telegram only reports online within a week; no exact time is available
userStatusLastMonth: Telegram only reports online within a month; no exact time is available
userStatusEmpty: Telegram did not provide presence information
WorkerInterrupted: Previous check was interrupted by a service restart
AccountNotReady: Telegram account is not signed in
TargetReconfigured: Configuration changed; waiting for fresh data
durationHint: Enter 1s, 1m, 2h 32m 1s, Chinese time units, or a number of seconds.
invalidDuration: Enter a whole duration within the allowed range, ordered from days to seconds.
scheduleTestHelp: Immediately send the saved message to this recipient, preserving the scheduled send time:
ruleTestHelp: Validate checks the current form and previews a simulated event without sending. Send test notification uses the saved rule to notify the configured Bark devices.
saveBeforeTest: Save your changes before sending a test. You can validate an unsaved rule draft.
validationFailed: Could not validate. Check required fields and JSON, then retry.
manualTestRequestFailed: The test request did not complete. Check delivery history before deciding whether to send again.
manualTestPartial: Some tests were sent; check failed items
viewTestDeliveries: View delivery history for this configuration
ruleInvalid: Current rule has problems to correct
previewOnly: This preview uses a simulated event and does not describe a real target transition.
InvalidRuleConfiguration: Check the rule name, event, required templates and parameter JSON.
MissingDestination: The selected Bark destination does not exist.
DestinationDisabled: Destination is disabled: automatic notifications will not send; manual tests still send.
MissingTarget: The selected target does not exist.
RuleDisabled: Rule is disabled: automatic notifications will not send; manual testing is available.
UnknownTemplateVariable: Unsupported template variable. Check its spelling.
ReservedBarkParameter: This parameter is controlled by the destination or template fields. Remove it from extra parameters.
NonNegativeIntegerRequired: Enter an integer greater than or equal to zero.
InvalidBarkLevel: Notification level must be critical, active, timeSensitive or passive.
InvalidOperationException: Cannot perform this operation. Check account sign-in and configuration.
TelegramException: Telegram rejected the send. Check the account and recipient.
HttpRequestException: Could not connect to the push server, or it rejected the notification.
TimeoutException: Send timed out; its outcome is uncertain. Check the receiving device.
OperationCanceledException: Send was interrupted; its outcome is uncertain. Check the receiving device.
